definitions.explanation: The parts of a region that lie among mountains, as opposed to plains or the coast. A standard term in weather forecasts.

examples.japanese: {山間部|さんかんぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧でしょう。
examples.english: Snow is expected in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {山間部|さんかんぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冷|ひ}え{込|こ}み→冷え込み：20445_hiekomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: In the mountain areas, mornings and evenings are bitterly cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{山間部|さんかんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集落|しゅうらく}→集落：19622_shuuraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{孤立|こりつ}→孤立：12229_koritsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the heavy rain, villages in the mountain areas are cut off.

notes:
Heard constantly in weather forecasts, paired with {平野部|へいやぶ} (the plains) and {沿岸部|えんがんぶ} (the coast).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山間部|さんかんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: mainly in the mountains
- {山間部|さんかんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集落|しゅうらく}→集落：19622_shuuraku⟧: mountain villages

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{山間|さんかん}→山間：12589_sankan⟧／{山間|やまあい}: among the mountains; a mountain valley (descriptive, also literary)
- ⟦{山地|さんち}→山地：12647_sanchi⟧: mountainous land (geography term)
